module: Flowgraph node "Blur" (repeat_instant, tags gfx/blur). Blurs the scene: pin blurAmount (0 to 1, default 1) becomes the alpha of a full-screen rectangle added to the ScreenBlurFX effect every render frame. Draws nothing if the CEF UI is not visible or if work has not run for more than 10 frames.

onPreRender.desc: Hook called before rendering (dt, dtSim); adds a full-screen blur rectangle to ScreenBlurFX if the node was active within the last 10 frames.

dt.desc: real time elapsed since the last frame (s)

postInit.desc: Configures the blurAmount pin as a float slider between 0 and 1.

work.desc: Stores the blur amount, the corresponding color and the current frame number.
